name: Eravikulam National Park Amenity Centre Restaurant
signature_dish: Basic Kerala meals and snacks — the forest-department canteen inside the park
why_it_matters: Eravikulam National Park — home of the Nilgiri Tahr — is a protected reserve where carrying outside food is prohibited and there is no commerce inside beyond the Kerala Forest & Wildlife Department's own facilities. The amenity centre restaurant and eco-shop at Rajamala, the park's tourist hub, is the only genuine on-site eating option.
insider_tip: This is a basic forest-department canteen, not a destination meal — eat light here and have a proper meal in Munnar town afterwards. Outside food is not allowed into the park. Expect simple Kerala fare, tea and snacks at the Rajamala amenity centre.
signature_address: Amenity Centre, Rajamala, Eravikulam National Park, Munnar, Idukki District, Kerala 685612

name: Lakkam Waterfalls Eco Shop & Cafe
signature_dish: Tea and snacks at the waterfall — a small forest eco-shop café
why_it_matters: Lakkam Waterfalls, on the Munnar-Marayoor road within the Eravikulam belt, has a small forest-managed eco-shop and café at the entrance — one of very few refreshment points in this protected, low-commerce zone between Munnar and Marayoor.
insider_tip: A waterfall tea-and-snacks stall, not a meal stop — have a chai after a dip in the falls (there are changing rooms and lockers). For a real meal, Rapsy and the Munnar town restaurants are a short drive away.
signature_address: Lakkam Waterfalls Eco Shop & Cafe, Munnar-Marayoor Road, Lakkam, Idukki District, Kerala 685612

name: Rapsy Restaurant
area: Main Bazaar, Munnar town — ~13km from Eravikulam NP gate
signature_dish: Kerala parotta with beef roast — plus the much-praised masala chai
why_it_matters: Eravikulam National Park has no proper restaurants inside or at its gate beyond the forest canteen, so visitors eat in Munnar town, roughly 13km away. Rapsy in the Munnar Main Bazaar is the town's most consistently recommended restaurant — Kerala parotta, biryani and a celebrated masala chai — and the natural meal stop before or after an Eravikulam visit.
insider_tip: Plan an Eravikulam visit for the morning (the park gate has timed slots) and a Rapsy lunch in Munnar town afterwards, ~13km away. Order the parotta with beef roast and the masala chai. Central in the Main Bazaar.
signature_address: Rapsy Restaurant, Main Bazaar, Munnar, Idukki District, Kerala 685612
